prompt: Give me an explanation on how a website was developed
judge_reasoning: Perception scan: N=4 with first-5-words after markers: [1] “Developing a website involves”, [2] “Designing a website's user interface”, [3] “Front-end development and back-end”, [4] “The role of a web developer”. Candidate 1 is the most direct and complete for a general “how a website was developed” explanation, covering planning/design/content, front-end, back-end, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Candidate 4 is also strong and detailed but frames the answer around a web developer’s role (more responsibilities than an end-to-end development walkthrough). Candidate 2 is UI-centric (omits major parts of full development), and candidate 3 mainly compares front-end vs back-end rather than describing the overall development process.
